# Translexi Studio

> The creative studio of Translexi: AI video production, English and Indonesian copywriting, and webtoon localization

Production house of Translexi (PT Solusi Bahasa Internasional), Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

## Pages

- [Translexi Studio — AI Video, Copywriting & Webtoon Localization](https://studio.translexi.com/): The creative studio of Translexi, a language house since 2009. AI video for brands, English–Indonesian copywriting, and webtoon localization for publishers.
- [AI Video Production Services for Brands — Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/ai-video/): AI video production for brands: ads and presenter videos, motion design, monthly social content, data-led strategy, verbatim subtitles, and voice-over.
- [English & Indonesian Copywriting Services — Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/copywriting/): Indonesian and English copy for global and Indonesian brands: landing pages, SEO content and tutorials, campaign copy, product microcopy, glossaries, transcreation.
- [Webtoon Localization Services for Publishers — Translexi Studio](https://studio.translexi.com/services/webtoon-localization/): Webtoon and comic localization: translation, cleanup and redraw, typesetting, lettering. 1,500+ jobs since 2019 for the same publisher.
- [Translexi Studio Services — AI Video, Copywriting, Webtoon](https://studio.translexi.com/services/): Everything Translexi Studio does: AI video production for brands, English and Indonesian copywriting, and webtoon and comic localization.
- [About Translexi Studio — The Creative Studio of Translexi](https://studio.translexi.com/about/): Translexi Studio is the creative studio of Translexi, a language house since 2009: AI video, English–Indonesian copywriting, and webtoon localization.
- [Contact Translexi Studio — Send a Video, Copy, or Webtoon Brief](https://studio.translexi.com/contact/): Reach Translexi Studio in Yogyakarta. Send a video or copywriting brief, or one webtoon episode. We reply with a direction and a cost estimate.
